Two questions could not be resolved read-only and are stated rather than inferred: whether 11 phantom settlement profit/loss values originated in archived migration 202604250005 or in the live grading path (both coalesce to the same constant and are observationally identical), and whether validating the constraint would surface violations beyond NULL, since VALIDATE CONSTRAINT is DDL and was deliberately not run.
A live-path defect found during the audit is filed separately rather than fixed here: settlement fails closed on NULL stake while grading, attribution and the Discord results path each substitute 1.
